blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — United Nations (UN) Secretary-General Antonio Guterres on Monday lauded the Association of Southeast Asian Nation (Asean) member states for their progress in negotiations for the code of conduct (COC) in the South China Sea. Guterres mentioned this in his opening remarks at the 16th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean)-UN Summit held at the Philippine International Convention Center. “I commend Asean’s efforts, including progress in negotiations on the Code of Conduct in the South China Sea,” Guterres said.
